summary: Sends the network "closing track" signal for the server session: encodes a progress-bar event, allocates and flags a network message object, dispatches it, clears the session open flag at this+0x29, builds a log-string node, and either appends it to the debug-log linked list at this+0x1B770..0x1B77C or frees it depending on the logging-enabled global at 0x007D0398. Returns the updated node count when appended, else the logging flag value, or the free result.

operations.description: Encode a progress-bar event via ProgressBarEventEncode(4, 37, 0, 255, low dword of dbl_8AFEA0, 1).
Obtain a message object with COMVTableCallVia0x60(*(this+0x3FB8)) and mark it active by writing byte 1 at v2+4.
Dispatch the "closing track" network message via NetworkSendDispatch with the packet v9, an encoded length derived from ((v9[0] >> 8) & 0x3FF) + 8, and the message object v2.
Invoke the COM virtual method with VirtualMethodDispatch(*(this+0x3FB8), v2) to send/commit the message.
Clear the session open/closed flag at this+0x29 (track closed).
Allocate an 8-byte log-string node; on success initialize *v4=0 and v4[1]=-1, otherwise v4=0.
Copy the "ClosingTrack" message string (aClosingTrack at 0x005C60F8) into the reallocated buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.

When the session type global dword_7C569C is not 5 and StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_1, 4876) succeeds, write the log line: DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, *v4) using byte_5EA438 as the fallback path when *v4 is null.

When dword_7D0398 (logging enabled) is nonzero and v4 is valid: allocate a 12-byte list node (v7[0]=v4, v7[4]=0, v7[8]=0) and append it to the debug-log linked list; when the head this+0x1B770 is set, link the previous tail this+0x1B774's +4 slot to v7, otherwise initialize head this+0x1B770 and secondary this+0x1B778 to v7; update the tail this+0x1B774 to v7 and increment the node count at this+0x1B77C.
Else when dword_7D0398 is zero and v4 is valid: free the string buffer *v4 with FreeWrapper_7bcf if non-null, free the node v4 itself, and return the free result.
Return the logging flag dword_7D0398 when no node was appended, or the updated node count from this+0x1B77C after a successful append.

The packet buffer v9 is written by NetworkSendDispatch; its structure and the ((v9[0]>>8)&0x3FF)+8 length derivation are not resolved.
